aggressive_definition: High-grade prostate cancer defined as Gleason score >7.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: Regarding prostate cancer aggressiveness, the 677TT genotype was associated with more than 50% decreased risk of high-grade prostate cancer (Gleason score >7) compared with the 677CC and 677CT genotypes (OR = 0.35, 95% CI = 0.24-0.64; P = 0.001).
reason: The abstract analyzes overall prostate cancer risk and separately analyzes incident high-grade prostate cancer among cases and cancer-free controls. The aggressive analysis concerns MTHFR genotype, not folate or vitamin B12 levels.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: There was no significant difference in plasma levels of tHcy, folate, and vitamin B12 between the two groups with any genotypes.
estimate_classifications.reason: This folate biomarker comparison is between overall prostate cancer cases and healthy controls. The abstract does not report a folate association specifically for high-grade disease.
